year_display.zh: 周代，约公元前 600 年以前

edition.en: The received Mao text as given on Chinese Wikisource, without the Mao preface, chapter count and notes. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库所载毛诗本，删去《毛诗序》、章句说明与注解。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: A song from the Book of Songs (Shijing), compiled by about the sixth century BCE.
basis.zh: 《诗经》中的诗篇，约于公元前六世纪编定。

note.en: The opening song of the Lesser Odes, sung at banquets for honoured guests for more than two thousand years; in later dynasties the feast for newly passed examination candidates was named after it. It is a poem about hospitality as a kind of learning: the host feeds his guests and in return they ‘show me the right road’. Cao Cao quoted its first four lines in his Short Song, which is one way a poem gets carried on.
note.zh: 《诗经·小雅》的第一篇，两千多年来在宴请嘉宾时歌唱；后世为新科举人设的宴会就叫“鹿鸣宴”。这是一首把待客当作求学的诗：主人款待客人，客人则“示我周行”。曹操在《短歌行》里引用了它的前四句，一首诗就是这样被传下去的。

excerpt.orig: 呦呦鹿鳴，食野之苹。我有嘉賓，鼓瑟吹笙。
excerpt.en: Yu, yu, the deer are calling, grazing on the wild sedge. / I have good guests with me: play the zither, blow the reed-pipes.
excerpt.zh: 呦呦鹿鸣，食野之苹。我有嘉宾，鼓瑟吹笙。

gloss.en: 苹 is a wild plant, traditionally glossed as a kind of mugwort; nothing to do with the apple, which shares the character in modern simplified Chinese.
gloss.zh: 苹：藾蒿，一种野草，与“苹果”无关。

gloss.en: 瑟 is a large plucked zither; 笙, a mouth organ of bamboo pipes. The 簧 of the next line is the reed inside the 笙.
gloss.zh: 瑟：弹拨乐器，似琴而大。笙：竹管排成的吹奏乐器。下句“簧”是笙管里的簧片。

gloss.en: 承筐: holding up baskets of gifts. 將: to present them.
gloss.zh: 承筐：捧着盛礼品的竹筐。将：奉献。

gloss.en: 周行: the great road, hence the right way.
式 is a particle; 燕 is 宴, to feast; 敖 is 遨, to be at ease.
gloss.zh: 式：语助词。燕：同“宴”。敖：同“遨”，逍遥。
